faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Rural Development & Panchayati Raj (NIRDPR) for filling up healthcare positions in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post is Lady Staff Nurse under advertisement number 22/2026, intended for temporary contractual engagement at the NIRDPR Health Centre.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Lady Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Lady Staff Nurse position, offering a stable contractual opportunity in the healthcare domain.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date and reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 2 November 2026. Candidates are required to report by 09:30 AM at the designated interview venue in Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q5. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at the NIRDPR Vikas Auditorium, Rajendranagar, Hyderabad - 500030, where certificate verification and tests will be held.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Nursing) degree, be registered as an 'A' grade nurse and 'A' grade midwife, and have at least 5 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years, calculated as on the date of the official notification issued by the Institute.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹35,000/- along with compulsory rent-free Type 'B' accommodation on the campus.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a passport-size photograph, a resume, one set of self-attested educational and experience copies, and all original certificates for verification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for NIRDPR Lady Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial certificate verification, a written test, and a personal interview conducted on the same day at the interview venue.
